Woman aboard a ship causing trouble

I am not sure from which film I know Harry Carey but Milburn Stone is "Doc Adams" of "Gunsmoke". Both do a good job here.

rv: In this atypical Jem Handy movie, the glories of America are narrowed down to the glories of Automobile production. The assembly line! From the historical re-enactments, with dialogue (if my memory serves me correctly, this is one of few rare times these films had actors saying anything rather then the narrator saying it for them)…

Anyway, this is a 15-minute exercise narrated by Chet Huntley, whose contract must have allowed him to do side work away from NBC. It's entitled "American Women, Partners in Research." If you think women are in the lab creating things, forget it. This is 1950s America. The "partnership" is looking at coffee percolators and seeing which one…
